Or the radiant glow of an undaunted spirit’s transcendence? And so he moves, and every gesture, as he stands there in his boyhood, proclaims him the future master of Beauty, through whose body eternal melodies will flow. That is how you will hear him, that is how you will see him, with a wonder never before known.

@@U03822@@
Daughter of Crete, is this what you call a marvel? Have you never heeded the instructive words of poets? Never known IJonia’s ancient tales, or Hellas’s ancestral legends of gods and heroes? Today is a dreary echo of glories past. Your story pales to the lovely lies our forebears sang of 赫耳墨斯, Maia’s son, tales more persuasive than truth. No sooner born, he’s bound in downy bands, and then again in sumptuous purple wrappings, by chattering nurses who know little what to expect. Slyly, then, the crafty little rogue works free his tender, limber limbs, leaving behind the wrappings, the purple shell that confined him, a butterfly slipping from the cell of its chrysalis, spreading its wings, flying freely in the radiant sunlight.

@@U03820@@
还是无畏精神的超越的光芒？他就这样移动着，他童年时站在那里的每一个动作都宣告着他是未来的美之大师，永恒的旋律将在他的身体中流淌。这就是你将如何听到他的声音，这就是你将如何看到他的方式，带着前所未有的惊奇。

@@U03822@@
克里特岛的女儿，这就是你所说的奇迹吗？难道你从来没有留意过诗人的教诲吗？从未了解过伊乔尼亚的古老故事，或希腊的众神和英雄的祖先传说？今天是过去辉煌的沉闷回声。你的故事与我们的祖先所唱的玛雅之子赫耳墨斯的可爱谎言相形见绌，故事比事实更有说服力。他一出生，就被一群喋喋不休的护士绑在柔软的带子里，然后又被裹上华丽的紫色包裹，他们不知道会发生什么。然后，狡猾的小盗贼狡猾地挣脱了他柔嫩的四肢，留下了包裹物，留下了限制他的紫色外壳，一只蝴蝶从蛹的细胞中滑落，展开翅膀，在灿烂的阳光下自由飞翔。
